debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e-d l-o-g-i-n a-t-t-e-m-p-t-s t-o c-u-s-t-o-m-e-r l-o-y-a-l-t-y a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s a-n-d g-i-f-t c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g b-e-h-i-n-d s-t-a-t-i-c s-c-r-i-p-t-s w-h-i-c-h r-u-n a-g-a-i-n-s-t p-r-o-d-u-c-t-i-o-n s-y-s-t-e-m-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e n-o-r-m-a-l a-c-c-e-s-s r-e-v-i-e-w a-n-d a-u-d-i-t s-t-e-p-s
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r t-o-o-k o-v-e-r i-n-d-i-v-i-d-u-a-l a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s b-y u-s-i-n-g c-a-p-t-u-r-e-d c-r-e-d-e-n-t-i-a-l-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g b-e-h-i-n-d m-o-d-i-f-i-e-d u-s-e-r p-r-o-f-i-l-e d-a-t-a a-n-d a-l-t-e-r-e-d p-a-s-s-w-o-r-d h-a-s-h-e-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-n-v-e-r-t-e-d g-i-f-t c-a-r-d v-a-l-u-e i-n-t-o c-a-s-h a-n-d p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l g-o-o-d-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g b-e-h-i-n-d t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n r-e-c-e-i-p-t-s a-n-d r-e-d-e-e-m p-r-o-o-f l-o-g-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e f-r-a-u-d a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s a-n-d v-e-l-o-c-i-t-y t-e-s-t s-t-e-p-s
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-a-d-e a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y a-p-p-e-a-r l-i-k-e n-o-r-m-a-l s-h-o-p-p-i-n-g b-y s-p-r-e-a-d-i-n-g p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e-s o-v-e-r t-i-m-e a-n-d u-s-i-n-g l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e m-e-r-c-h-a-n-t c-o-d-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g b-e-h-i-n-d b-e-n-c-h m-a-r-k e-d t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n h-i-s-t-o-r-y, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e a-n-o-m-a-l-y d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n a-l-e-r-t s-t-e-p-s
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-e-d t-h-e f-u-l-l c-h-a-i-n o-f c-o-m-m-a-n-d-s i-n a s-i-n-g-l-e f-i-l-e d-e-s-c-r-i-b-i-n-g e-v-e-r-y p-h-a-s-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g b-e-h-i-n-d t-h-e e-x-h-i-b-i-t i-t-s-e-l-f a-s a p-l-a-i-n t-e-x-t r-e-c-o-r-d, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d c-l-e-a-n-u-p a-n-d i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t r-e-p-o-r-t s-t-e-p-s
